edges.reason: msg.sender identity flows into transfer and determines the debited account via transferFrom(msg.sender,...)

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to feed the transfer wrapper and can be folded into the transfer function node.
The _value parameter has meaning only as the amount argument of transfer, so it merges into fn_transfer.
The _from parameter is the account checked and debited by transferFrom, so it normalizes into that function.
The _to parameter is the credited account inside transferFrom and merges into that function node.
The _value parameter drives the unchecked balance updates in transferFrom and merges into it.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
The _value parameter is only used as the allowance amount written by approve.
The target address parameter only feeds the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
The calldata parameter only feeds the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
The saleNum parameter is only consumed by the init configuration function.
The token parameter is only consumed by init when deriving _minSale.
The maxToken parameter is only consumed by init when deriving _maxSale.
The _tos array parameter is only consumed by batchSend for its airdrop loop.
The _value parameter is the operand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length unsafe operation.
The total local holds the unchecked product that overflows to bypass the balance require in batchSend.
The loop recipient local is internal bookkeeping of the batchSend airdrop loop.
The loop counter local only controls iteration inside batchSend.
The addr parameter is only written to tradeAddress by the setTradeAddress function.
The _value parameter is the amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.
The _from parameter is the whitelist subject tested inside ensure.
The _value parameter is only forwarded from ensure into condition.
